subject: BridgeGrove privacy & compliance recap — DPA/SCC path + VSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Navarro <eli@bridgegrove.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap / compliance pathing (SOC 2, HIPAA, DPA)

Hi Eli — great speaking with you and the BridgeGrove team today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call highlights
- BridgeGrove: interested in Redwood for production inference (chat + embeddings) across US & EU clients.
- You asked about SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA readiness, and how we handle DPA/SCC selection and controller vs processor roles.

Proposed next steps (short timeline)
1) I’ll share our SOC 2 report and a standard BAA/BAA template you can review — target: today.
2) Legal & Security: I’ll loop them in to confirm recommended SCC module and whether we should sign as processor or discuss controller/processor split for the integration.
3) Kick off Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ) — link below; we ask your team to complete within 7 business days.
4) Schedule a 30-min technical follow-up to review data flows and retention for HIPAA-sensitive use cases.

Ask from your side
- Please confirm who on your legal/procurement team should receive the DPA draft and VSQ.
- If you have a preferred SCC module (we can recommend one) or specific redlines up front, send them to Samir so we can triage.

I’ve attached the SOC 2 report stub and a standard BAA for your legal team to look at. VSQ link: https://vsq.redwood.ai/surveys/bridgegrove-01 (staged — you’ll get a personalized email from our security platform once we add your contacts).

Thanks — I’ll loop Laura (Legal) and Vivek (Security) to give you definitive language for the DPA/SCC choice.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap / compliance pathing (SOC 2, HIPAA, DPA)

Thanks, Soojin — helpful recap. Quick answers:
- Samir is our primary legal contact for DPAs/SCCs. I’ve cc’d him.
- Procurement will own contract cadence; I copied them as well.
- Timeline: procurement wants the DPA/contract draft and SOC 2 within this week if possible.

For HIPAA: we’ll have a separate technical call to map PHI flows. Can you indicate whether Redwood will act solely as processor for that workload or if BridgeGrove needs to be controller/processor split?

We’ll start the VSQ once we receive the link. Thanks for looping legal/security.

—Eli
Eli Navarro
Head of Platform, BridgeGrove
eli@bridgegrove.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bridgegrove.com>, Eli Navarro <eli@bridgegrove.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap / compliance pathing (SOC 2, HIPAA, DPA)

Samir / Eli — looping in our Legal and Security leads to confirm specifics and share the actual files. Laura: can you advise on DPA/SCC module recommendation for BridgeGrove (multi-region; US + EU customers) and attach the DPA draft? Vivek: please confirm SOC 2 availability and any HIPAA BAA notes.

High-level guidance we often follow
- For most customers serving EU PII where Redwood only processes on customers’ behalf, we recommend the Controller/Processor split with Redwood as processor and BridgeGrove as controller — then sign our DPA + SCC Module 2 (processor-focused) unless the customer requires a bespoke arrangement.
- If BridgeGrove wants Redwood to assume more responsibility (rare), we can discuss SCC Module 1 variants, but that requires legal review and dataflow mapping.

Deliverables (I’ll ensure these are delivered today):
- SOC 2 report link and stub PDF (Vivek)
- Draft DPA + SCC Module recommendation (Laura)
- BAA template for HIPAA exchanges (attached)
- VSQ survey link and next steps for BridgeGrove procurement

Thanks all — ideally Samir can flag any redlines right away so we can address before procurement issues a PO.

Best,
Soojin
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@bridgegrove.com>, Eli Navarro <eli@bridgegrove.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap / compliance pathing (SOC 2, HIPAA, DPA)

Hi all — quick security note and attachments.

What I’m sharing now:
- redwood_soc2_report_Q3_2026.pdf (stub) — link: https://redwood.share/docs/soc2-q3-2026
- redwood_standard_baa_template.docx (stub) — for HIPAA workloads, we can sign our standard BAA; if BridgeGrove needs custom clauses, send them over.
- vsq_link_stub.txt — the VSQ platform will email your respondents; I can add Samir and procurement contacts if you confirm.

SCC / DPA recommendation (security perspective)
- Recommendation: SCC Module 2 (processor-focused) for standard BridgeGrove integration. It maps cleanly to our operational controls and limits contractual risk for both parties.
- If BridgeGrove requires Redwood to act as controller for any processing (e.g., Redwood enriches PII independently), we need a separate commercial/tech evaluation.

HIPAA notes
- Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads under a signed BAA. For PHI flows we’ll need the technical deep-dive to confirm encryption-in-transit, retention, and deletion semantics.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_report_Q3_2026.pdf (stub), redwood_standard_baa_template.docx (stub)

-Vivek

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few items from Legal/Procurement: 
1) We’ll review the SOC 2 and BAA this afternoon. If the DPA uses SCC Module 2 and Redwood signs as processor, that should be fine — procurement will review commercial terms.
2) Please add me and procurement@bridgegrove.com to the VSQ recipients. We’ll aim to complete the VSQ within 5 business days.
3) Proposed timeline: DPA draft + redlines back to Redwood by next Tuesday. If possible, can Laura include a short paragraph in the DPA about subprocessor notification windows? That helps our legal team evaluate SLA/notice obligations.

I’ll coordinate internally and revert with any redlines. Looking forward to the technical mapping call for HIPAA next week — Eli will share a list of expected PHI categories.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Senior Counsel, BridgeGrove
